name: Anubhab Das
bio: Final-year B.Tech Computer Science graduate and AI Engineer with hands-on experience building and deploying Generative AI applications in production. Builds LLM-powered chatbots, assistants and agentic pipelines with LangChain/LangGraph, with practical work in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, LLM response evaluation, and integrating AI into enterprise applications through APIs. Currently a Software Developer (Intern) at AIVOA.ai (https://aivoa.ai/), building an AI-powered, agentic eQMS (electronic Quality Management System) platform for pharmaceutical/GxP clients, where output accuracy, traceability and regulatory compliance are core requirements.
education: B.Tech in Computer Science from Elitte College of Engineering (MAKAUT), Kolkata, 2023–2026, CGPA: 8 / 10

experience.description: Building QMS.AIVOA.AI, an agentic AI-powered eQMS platform for pharmaceutical/GxP clients. Developed a 5-stage Temporal workflow orchestrating LLM-powered investigation analysis for the Non-Conformance module, with an iterative self-critique loop that evaluates each response against a 10-point quality rubric. Built an autonomous documentation agent (Browser Use, Playwright, LangGraph) that crawls the platform to collect and structure content into a navigation knowledge base feeding a Pinecone-backed RAG pipeline. Designed a context-isolated session architecture for an AI chat assistant, enabling multi-record conversational workflows across QMS record types. Built a Python calculation engine for pharmaceutical cleaning-validation limits (Maximum Allowable Carryover), implementing HBEL/PDE, dose-based, 10ppm, and LD50/NOEL methods to comply with FDA/EMA/PIC/S/WHO standards, plus a worst-case-product ranking engine. Built a recursive PostgreSQL CTE-based traceability graph with React Flow/Dagre visualization and role-based access control, replacing a slower Python-level graph traversal. Architected and implemented a 9-stage Supplier Corrective Action Request (SCAR) workflow end-to-end, including seed datasets and a Jinja2/WeasyPrint HTML-to-PDF report generation pipeline.
Built and deployed multiple Generative AI applications including RAG pipelines, LLM-powered agents, and AI-integrated portfolio tools.
